name: clinic-api

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in client; the gateway validates tokens issued through it.

dependencies.name: clinic-db
dependencies.description: Dedicated Postgres storing slots, appointments and visit notes; owned exclusively by this service.

description: The single backend for slots, appointments, check-in and visit notes. Enforces no double booking (transactionally against its own clinic-db), the 2-hour cancel/reschedule cutoff, same-day check-in, and doctor-only access to visit notes. Does not send notifications, run background jobs, store files or call external systems.
